title: qct3d-saturation: code and derived data for 'Quantum or just quantised? Angle-encoder saturation confounds ansatz and placement comparisons in hybrid models for 3D CT'
description: Analysis code (Colab notebooks and a small Python package) and the aggregate result tables behind every figure and table of the article Quantum or just quantised? Angle-encoder saturation confounds ansatz and placement comparisons in hybrid models for 3D CT (submitted to Quantum Machine Intelligence). The release contains no patient-level data: the external cohort is protected health information and is available only under an institutional data-sharing agreement; the development cohort is the public RSNA 2019 Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection dataset.
